purpose: Replicate the SW0117 joint analytic-RGB treatment on source seeds 1 and 2 to test whether the seed-0 paired signal generalizes across registered source initializations.

historical_reference.interpretation: The seed-0 difference and paired interval motivated replication, but the registered SW0117 +0.01 promotion gate failed. This study does not retroactively promote SW0117 or claim that the recipe already generalizes.

source_and_arms.source: Whole matched SW0097 positive_frozen checkpoint for the same seed; registered shared encoder and preprocessing remain fixed at their existing artifact SHAs.
source_and_arms.source_evaluation: Use the evaluation.json colocated with the trained SW0097 seed checkpoint and COMPLETED marker; validate exact IDs, finite 320 per-image metrics, recomputed means, prediction GT=false, then bind its SHA into preflight and training manifests.
source_and_arms.control: Original phase primary + 5 * positive actual four-component Q, with encoder, legacy graph, and whole core trainable.
source_and_arms.candidate: Same initialized model, ordering, optimizer, and old objective as the paired control, plus the unchanged SW0115 decoder-free analytic RGB loss.
source_and_arms.historical_seed0: SW0117's completed seed-0 source/control/candidate and calibration artifact are read-only references. SW0117 files, status, and promotion decision are not changed.

training.ordered_training_ids: Each seed uses that seed's exact registered SW0097 4096-ID sequence.
training.shuffle_seed: 117 + source seed: 118 for seed 1 and 119 for seed 2.
training.optimizer: Fresh Adam for each new arm; no optimizer state is claimed or copied from seed 0.
training.lambda_source: Exact immutable SW0117 seed-0 calibration artifact. The value is shared unchanged for both seeds; no per-seed recalibration is allowed.
training.loss_and_readout: Unchanged SW0117/SW0115 forward, actual positive four-component Pearson-product Q, phase primary, 5*positive-Q term, production .50/min2/largest-component-background partition H, exact-forward STE and native RGB patch means.

required_preflight: Validate all completed SW0117 seed-0 reference arms, calibration value and source artifact provenance without modifying them.
Validate the seed-specific SW0097 source checkpoint, source manifest, ordered 4096 IDs and completed original full-320 source evaluation SHA/metrics.

Regenerate each seed's gamma from the registered RGB cache and encoder; report cached-versus-live input differences, enforce the existing 2e-5 gamma/old-loss bounds and exact production H, and require exact same-input source-reference traces/loss/H.

On the same first four registered TRAIN batches, require finite nonzero old gradients for encoder, graph and non-graph core; candidate additionally requires finite nonzero RGB gradients for Q and all three parameter families.

Require fixed count-preserving H-row scramble to increase RGB loss; run a separate throwaway B16 Adam update and verify encoder, graph and core parameters actually change. No masks/GT are read during preflight or training.

registered_replication_gate.three_seed_means: Mean over SW0117 seed0 plus SW0122 seeds1/2; candidate must exceed both the three-source SW0097 mean and the matched old-only control mean in FG-ARI.
registered_replication_gate.seed_consistency: Candidate must exceed its matched SW0097 source FG-ARI in at least two of the three seeds.
registered_replication_gate.paired_uncertainty: Use a fixed 10,000-draw paired-image bootstrap for both candidate-minus-control and candidate-minus-matched-SW0097-source FG-ARI. Each bootstrap draw uses the same sampled image indices across all three seeds (historical SW0117 seed0 plus SW0122 seeds1/2); both 95% CI lower bounds must be positive.
registered_replication_gate.iou_margins: Candidate three-seed means must exceed matched Slot means by more than 0.05 for foreground IoU and matched-object IoU.
registered_replication_gate.failure: Report all seeds and stop the recipe. No coefficient/threshold tuning, seed selection, or automatic expansion.

limitations: This is a matched 256-update replication, not another 70k exposure pass.
Seed 0 is reused as historical evidence; no new seed-0 training is performed.
A positive result does not change the failed SW0117 promotion decision; it is a separately registered replication summary.
